description: List queue activity. The activity feed of the project's queue items, newest first: every status, priority, owner, tag and content change, every comment, every alert acknowledgement, and every pull-request event (`linked`, `unlinked`, `merged`, `closed` unmerged). Each entry names the item it belon…

field.description: Which kind of change an activity entry records. `pr` is a pull-request event (see `pr.event`); `comment` carries an excerpt in `to`; `edit` names the edited content fields in `added`.

item.description: Narrow to one item — its per-project number (e.g. `7`) or full id. Omit for the whole project.

limit.description: Maximum entries to return (1-200). Defaults to 100.

since.description: Only entries strictly after this ISO-8601 instant.

until.description: Only entries strictly before this ISO-8601 instant.

name: ops_activity_list
